title: Use Seedance 2.5 for UGC/ecom/affiliate ad elements like hooks, b-rolls…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 for UGC/ecom/affiliate ad elements like hooks, b-rolls, complex animations, commercial-style ads, and Netflix documentary-style ads rather than talking/lip-sync-heavy scenes  
Avoid relying on Seedance 2.5 for lip-sync/talking parts if you want the most convincing realism  
Combine Seedance 2.5 with Omni Flash to produce stronger ecom/affiliate ads

es.content:
Usa Seedance 2.5 para elementos de anuncios UGC/ecom/affiliate como hooks, b-rolls, animaciones complejas, anuncios de estilo comercial y anuncios al estilo documental de Netflix, en lugar de escenas con mucho talking/lip-sync.  
Evita depender de Seedance 2.5 para las partes de lip-sync/talking si quieres el realismo más convincente.  
Combina Seedance 2.5 con Omni Flash para producir anuncios ecom/affiliate más potentes.

fr.content:
Utilisez Seedance 2.5 pour des éléments UGC/ecom/affiliate tels que les hooks, les b-rolls, les animations complexes, les publicités au style commercial et les publicités au style documentaire Netflix, plutôt que pour des scènes fortement axées sur le lip-sync et la parole.  
Évitez de vous appuyer sur Seedance 2.5 pour les parties de lip-sync/parole si vous voulez obtenir le réalisme le plus convaincant.  
Combinez Seedance 2.5 avec Omni Flash pour produire des publicités ecom/affiliate plus percutantes.

ja.content:
UGC／ecom／affiliate向けの広告要素、たとえばフック、B-roll、複雑なアニメーション、商業広告風の映像、Netflixドキュメンタリー風の広告には、話し中心やリップシンク中心のシーンよりも Seedance 2.5 を使う  
最も説得力のあるリアリズムを求めるなら、リップシンク／会話パートを Seedance 2.5 に頼りすぎない  
より強力な ecom／affiliate 広告を作るには、Seedance 2.5 と Omni Flash を組み合わせる

ko.content:
UGC/ecom/affiliate 광고 요소인 훅, b-roll, 복잡한 애니메이션, 상업 광고 스타일의 광고, Netflix 다큐멘터리 스타일 광고에는 말하거나 립싱크가 많은 장면보다 Seedance 2.5를 사용하세요  
가장 설득력 있는 사실감을 원한다면 립싱크/대화 장면에 Seedance 2.5를 과도하게 의존하지 마세요  
더 강력한 ecom/affiliate 광고를 만들려면 Seedance 2.5를 Omni Flash와 결합하세요

pt.content:
Use o Seedance 2.5 para elementos de anúncios UGC/ecom/afiliados, como hooks, b-rolls, animações complexas, anúncios em estilo comercial e anúncios em estilo documentário da Netflix, em vez de cenas com muita fala/lip-sync  
Evite depender do Seedance 2.5 para partes de lip-sync/fala se você quiser o realismo mais convincente  
Combine o Seedance 2.5 com o Omni Flash para produzir anúncios ecom/afiliados mais fortes

zh.content:
将 Seedance 2.5 用于 UGC/ecom/affiliate 广告元素，例如 hooks、b-roll、复杂动画、商业风格广告以及 Netflix 纪录片风格广告，而不是依赖大量说话/口型同步的场景  
如果你想要最逼真的效果，尽量不要把 lip-sync/说话部分主要交给 Seedance 2.5  
将 Seedance 2.5 与 Omni Flash 结合使用，可以制作出更强的 ecom/affiliate 广告
